name: skill-search
description: Routes coding agents to the right skill for the moment they are in

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=skill/scripts/skill-search.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
